question: **As per the passage, when we face difficult times:**

options.text: our minds get overcome by negative thoughts
we start changing our views on life
we look at them as opportunities for improvement
we become passively engaged in overcoming them

solution:
The correct answer is: **our minds get overcome by negative thoughts**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first and second sentence of the first paragraph in the given passage states that- *"Difficult times could create feelings of anxiety, insecurity, and fear__. As we navigate through undesirable situations and uncertainties, __we find that negativities surrounding the problems consume our mind__.**"*
 
• That means "**Anxiety, insecurity, and fear can arise during trying times. We discover that as we navigate through unpleasant situations and uncertainties, thoughts about the issues dominate our thinking.**"

From here we can conclude that option 1 is the right answer.
